name: WAVE Evaluation Tool
summary: WebAIM's evaluation extension injects icons and indicators onto the live page to flag accessibility errors, alerts and structural issues, with all analysis done locally in the browser.
browsersNote: wave.webaim.org/extension states a WAVE Edge extension exists, but no Edge Add-ons listing was confirmed in store search.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Seeing errors, alerts and structure issues overlaid on the live page.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: wave webaim accessibility evaluation errors alerts structure contrast
